name: Shojo Shikkaku ~Hajimete wa Anata ni Sasagetakatta~
original_name: 処女失格 ～初めては貴方に捧げたかった～
source:
Chigimi is a cute little stuffed doll who lives a happy life with her beloved Gokaku-san, an high-ranking exec at a major company.

One day Gokaku-san leaves for work without his important documents and Chigimi sets out on an adventure alone to deliver them to his office.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_110546zero/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
千姬是一只可爱的毛绒玩偶，和心爱的五角先生过着幸福的生活。五角先生是大型企业的高管。

一天，五角先生忘记带重要文件就去上班了。千姬独自踏上冒险之旅，准备把文件送到他的办公室。

[译自[url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_110546zero/]DMM[/url]]
